summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run or committed.

Changes:
- rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative DFS with explicit stack, 4-cell indent per level, expanded nodes only) and the Measurement import.
- rich/align.py: Align rendering now constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width); added Align.__repr__; added public VerticalCenter (render with newline-segment padding from console.size.height, measurement delegated, repr). Not registered in rich/__init__.py.
- rich/console.py: print's render options use justify="default"; the justify argument still goes into _collect_renderables unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 heading marked Unreleased; existing bullet kept; Added subsection with the two new entries.
- tests/test_align.py: VerticalCenter import; repr tests for Align and VerticalCenter; VerticalCenter render (height 6, expects "\n\nfoo\n\n\n") and measure (3, 3) tests.
- tests/test_tree.py: Measurement import; measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19).

Not verified: tests were not run. The Console(height=6) render test in particular depends on how print handles a non-text renderable and should be confirmed by running pytest on tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py, then the full suite. No commits were made.
